title: Prachyam — Brochure
desc: Prachyam’s story, told through illustrated spreads and typography.
lead: I designed Prachyam’s brochure, bringing its story into print through cultural collages, typography and editorial layouts.
body: I designed a brochure introducing Prachyam and the ideas behind its work. English and Devanagari typography sit alongside cultural collages and an illustrated timeline, with orange accents and recurring page details connecting the spreads.
detail: I paired large collages and an illustrated timeline with quieter areas for text. Warm orange accents, fine rules and recurring page details connect the spreads.
contribution: Designed the cover and interior editorial layouts.
Combined cultural imagery, illustration and typography to carry the brand’s story across the brochure.
summary: I designed Prachyam’s brochure, bringing its story into print through cultural collages, typography and editorial layouts.
